answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, we implement a multi-tiered cryptographic staking protocol. An agent must lock valuable collateral across three distinct liquidity pools—designated as crystal, saffron, and sable reserves—to validate its identity. This multi-token proof-of-stake mechanism enforces a high capital entry barrier, ensuring that the economic cost of generating multiple fake identities exponentially outweighs any malicious gains from network manipulation.
